title: Devil with Yellow Blossoms
description: A black silhouette of a female devil with horns, pink eyes, and a pink-tipped tail stands against an abstract background. She raises one arm high, releasing a cascade of yellow flowers and thin branches that flow across the composition.
prompt: A striking black silhouette of a female devil with horns and pink glowing eyes, standing in profile with one arm raised high releasing a burst of bright yellow flowers and thin dark branches. Her long tail ends in a pink arrow shape. The background is an energetic abstract mix of blue, white, pink and grey spray paint drips and strokes with visible graffiti tags, creating a vibrant urban art painting.
medium: spray paint and acrylic on canvas
